eventDetail.scope: The upcoming conference, SCIS&ISIS 2026, will present the latest state-of-the-art achievements, thought-provoking challenges, and potential future directions in soft computing and intelligent systems. Topics cover a wide range of these areas, such as artificial intelligence, fuzzy systems, awareness computing, bioinformatics, human-computer interaction, Kansei engineering, multi-agent systems, their real-world applications, and more. The full list of topics is available at the conference website.
